title: Practise law only as a legal practitioner
what: Practise law, or hold out as entitled to, only as a local or interstate legal practitioner.

sources.title: Legal Practitioners Act 1981 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A natural person must not practise the profession of the law, or hold himself or herself out, or permit another to hold him or her out, as being entitled to practise the profession of the law unless the person— (a) is a local legal practitioner; or (b) is an interstate legal practitioner
